pattern: Multi-line textbox (contenteditable, role=textbox, aria-multiline) with an associated WAI-ARIA toolbar (roving tabindex) and a labelled link editor group.

aria.value: Help text, counter, and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown
"true" when disabled (the content is also removed from the tab order)

aria.element: toggle tools (block types, marks, lists, quote, code block, alignment)
aria.value: "true" when the format applies at the selection
"true" when read-only/disabled, nothing to undo/redo, or marks/link inside a code block (tools stay focusable)
Localized command name (also the title tooltip)
Set when the URL policy rejects the address; describes it with the link error message

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the toolbar (one tab stop), the content, and the rest of the page (native).
Indents / outdents the list items (depth 0-4).
Leaves the editor instead of indenting (no keyboard trap).

Splits the block into a new paragraph or list item; at the end of a heading starts a paragraph; in an empty list item outdents or leaves the list; in an empty quote leaves it; in a code block inserts a line break and on an empty last line leaves it; after a line of ``` (Markdown shortcuts) creates a code block.
Inserts a line break within the block (browser insertLineBreak).
List item: outdents, then becomes a paragraph; heading, quote, or empty code block: becomes a paragraph; otherwise merges with the previous block.

keyboard.key: Backspace / Delete and their word/line variants (for example Ctrl+Backspace)
keyboard.action: Deletes a grapheme cluster, word, or line (as the browser reports it) through the model; Delete at the end of a block merges the next block.
Toggles bold / italic / underline on the selection, or for the next typed text when the selection is collapsed.
Toggles strikethrough / inline code.
Opens the link panel for the selection or the link at the caret.
Toggles numbered / bulleted list.
Normal text / heading 1 / heading 2 / heading 3 (heading toggles back to normal text).
Align start / center / end / justify.
Undo.
Redo.
Moves focus to the toolbar (its current tab-stop tool).
Previous / next tool in DOM order, wrapping (roving tabindex).
First / last tool.
Runs the command and returns focus to the content (the Link tool opens the link panel).
Returns focus to the content.
Applies the link (or shows the error when the URL policy rejects it); focus returns to the content.
Closes the panel without changes; focus returns to the content.
Moves between the address, Apply, Remove link, and Cancel buttons (native).

focus: The surface shows the focus indicator when the content has :focus-visible (border and 1px ring in color-focus-ring). Toolbar tools and link panel buttons use a focus-ring-width outline in color-focus-ring. Focus returns to the content with the previous selection after toolbar commands and when the link panel closes.
notes: Mod is Ctrl on Windows and Linux and Cmd on Apple platforms.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; required state is conveyed by aria-required.
Errors appear after focus leaves the component by default, then update live.
Formatting changes from toolbar clicks, block type changes, undo/redo, and link add/remove are announced through a polite live region.
Pressed tools use selected colors plus a border, so the state is not conveyed by color alone.
Clicking the label focuses the content; toolbar mouse presses keep the editor's selection.
axe WCAG 2.2 AA passes in the default, dark, and high-contrast themes with the link panel open and the invalid state shown (e2e).
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior (reading of formatted content, toolbar state, announcements) has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
IME composition and mobile virtual keyboards have been tested only in Chromium.
Toolbar arrow keys are not mirrored in right-to-left layouts.
The character counter is not announced through a live region; it is referenced by aria-describedby.
